children: The Philippines’ budget deficit widened sharply to PHP 161.3 billion in August 2026 from PHP 84.8 billion in the corresponding month of the previous year.
Total revenues declined 1.85% year-on-year to PHP 346 billion, driven largely by a 35.59% drop in non-tax revenues, while tax collections increased 0.32%.

Total expenditures soared 16.0% to PHP 507.3 billion, mainly due to higher health insurance funding for low-income people, senior citizens, and other eligible patients, as well as larger tax transfers to local governments.
Primary expenditures rose 18.03%, accounting for 87.06% of total spending, while interest payments grew 3.98% amid higher debt servicing costs and foreign-exchange fluctuations.
In the January–August period, the country recorded a budget shortfall of PHP 1,054.3 billion, up from PHP 869.2 billion in the same period last year.

title: Philippines Budget Deficit Widens in August
